subsections.text: Graduating BS Computer Science student from the University of the Philippines Diliman with hands-on experience building full-stack web applications, mobile software, and video games. Proven ability to learn unfamiliar tools quickly, take ownership of backend and gameplay systems, and deliver maintainable products in team-based and client-facing environments. Strong foundation in scalable system design, rapid prototyping, and end-to-end development from architecture to user experience.

subsections.title: Unity Game Designer & Developer ( Metrocycle 2.0 )
subsections.subtitle: Team of 3 | Undergraduate Thesis Project, Unity 3D, C#, Android, GitHub
items: Collaborated with 2 teammates to expand Metrocycle, a motorcycle road-safety game originally built for web.
Took ownership of a large existing codebase, learning its architecture independently to build for scalability and maintainability.
Led the Android porting effort, debugging broken systems and optimizing performance for mobile devices.
Implemented gameplay systems including avatar customization, modular minigames, weather effects, and localization.
Contributed UI/UX improvements for accessibility and clearer educational delivery.
Documented development decisions and system behavior to support future maintenance and iteration.
Presented the project at the Workshop on Computation: Theory and Practice 2025 in Hokkaido, Japan for publishing.

subsections.title: Full-Stack Developer Intern ( UP FLCD éLaan )
subsections.subtitle: Team of 5 | Client-Based Internship, Agile, SvelteKit, PostgreSQL, GitHub
items: Initiated and executed a freelance-style internship with a university department to digitize its booking workflow.
Co-led agile development through sprint planning, task coordination, and regular client check-ins.
Architected and implemented the core backend system, starting from a normalized PostgreSQL database schema.
Developed dynamic, validated form workflows in SvelteKit, integrating frontend inputs with backend endpoints.
Built role-based booking flows to support different user types and request scenarios.
Rapidly learned and applied Svelte, SvelteKit, and PostgreSQL to deliver a production-ready system within tight timelines.

subsections.title: IoT Companion Web Application ( Labuddy )
subsections.subtitle: Team of 6 | Backend, IoT Integration, Dragon's Den / Product Pitch, React, Supabase, GitHub
items: Co-led backend development for an IoT-enabled laundry sorting system with a real-time web companion app.
Designed and implemented backend systems using Supabase and MySQL to manage device data and transactions.
Collaborated with frontend developers to ensure smooth API integration and data consistency.
Contributed to UX flow and system behavior to improve interaction between users and IoT hardware.
Presented the system in a Dragon's Den-style pitch, communicating technical feasibility and product value.

subsections.title: QR-Based Class Attendance Mobile Application ( RollCall )
subsections.subtitle: Team of 5 | Full-Stack Mobile App, Agile Development, Ionic React, Supabase, GitHub
items: Developed a mobile application that automates classroom attendance through QR code scanning and session validation.
Implemented backend services using Supabase for authentication, attendance records, and course data.
Designed relational database structures and validation rules to prevent duplicate or invalid attendance logs.
Integrated frontend components with backend services to provide real-time attendance feedback.
Worked in an agile environment with weekly standups and iterative improvements based on client feedback.

items.Front-end Development: React (Ionic React, React Native), Svelte & SvelteKit
items.Game Development: Unity 3D, Gameplay Systems, Mobile Optimization, Software Architecture
items.Development Practices: Version Control (Git, GitHub), Agile Methodology, Documentation
items.Soft Skills: Flexibility, Effective Communication, Continuous Improvement, Receptive to Feedback, Problem-solving
